prompt: Find and quote the exact regex or URL-parsing code used to extract the Instagram post/reel shortcode or ID from a pasted URL. Include support for /p/, /reel/, /reels/, /tv/, /stories/, profile-scoped URLs, and share URLs if present. Quote the exact code.
content:
# Instagram Post ID Extraction Regex

Based on the GitHub repository content, here's the exact regex code used:

```javascript
const regex = /instagram.com\/(?:[A-Za-z0-9_.]+\/)?(p|reels|reel|stories)\/([A-Za-z0-9-_]+)/;
const match = url.match(regex);
return match && match[2] ? match[2] : null;
```

This pattern captures Instagram shortcodes from URLs by:
- Matching `instagram.com/`
- Optionally capturing username paths
- Targeting post types: `/p/`, `/reels/`, `/reel/`, or `/stories/`
- Extracting the alphanumeric shortcode (group 2) containing letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores

The code returns the shortcode if matched, or null for invalid URLs.
